item.title: ResourceStorage
item.description:
Development reference · Larecs 1.0.0b1 · revision 24a607075a78. Host threading and device execution are experimental. Compatibility and status.

Mojo structSource

ResourceStorage

@memory_only
struct ResourceStorage

Manages resources.

Every resource carries a revision that conservatively advances on each Larecs access that may mutate it (decision 0021). Worlds that opt into device copy reuse skip uploading resources whose device copy was transferred at the current revision. Mutations through references obtained before a later Larecs call, or through raw pointers, are not detected: re-obtain references after a run, or call invalidate_device[T]().

get

Gets a resource.

def get[T: ResourceType](ref self) -> ref[SomeUnsafeAnyOrigin] T

Note: Keep UnsafeAnyOrigin until Mojo’s origin system can model the ownership relation between the resource container and its separately allocated resource values. Tying this reference to the storage origin is not a suitable interim replacement.

Through mutable storage, every call counts as a mutation and invalidates the resource’s device copy, even if the reference is only read. Use read for reads between device runs. Writes through a reference kept across a later run are not detected; re-obtain it or call invalidate_device[T]().

Parameters:

Args:

  • self (Self)

Returns:

Raises:

Error: If the resource is missing, leased, or storage is unusable.

read

Gets an immutable resource reference without counting a mutation.

def read[T: ResourceType](self) -> ref[ImmUnsafeAnyOrigin] T
